'''Rotgut''' was a form of [[Alcohol/Legends|alcohol]] that was served in bottles.<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref> The [[Nova Blades]] were known to have drank the beverage.<ref name="Dantooine">{{TORcite|Dantooine}}</ref>
